description: This file defines the DestroyCandidatePurgeStrategy class, which extends PurgeStrategy, and implements a data purge mechanism for Candidate entities based on user consent within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DestroyCandidatePurgeStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class for purging Candidate entities that do not consent to data retention, used within the OrangeHRM maintenance module.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Removes Candidate entities associated with a specific vacancy ID if they do not have consent to keep data.
